text_block_list.text:
When I came to the cafeteria,
there was a crowd of people gathered for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, everyone's here~! What's up?
You guys kind of have a... troubled vibe going on?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: There's a system malfunction at the academy. It seems they weren't able to order the ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text: I tried contacting the supplier directly too, but it seems they can't do anything because of the difference in quantity~.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"We managed to get by for today, but
at this rate, tomorrow's lunch is..."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
What?!
Does that mean no lunch~?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What did you think of the idea
of checking with other vendors?

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
I asked around at a bunch of places, but since it's so short notice,
nobody seems to have any extra in stock.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... Hmm, then let's try
negotiating with the local shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, it didn't pan out. As expected, nowhere has enough stock for the whole academy...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Grrr...
The carrots in the field are still too early to harvest, and...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Yep!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Maya just figured it out!
A great solution☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Listen, listen! Tomorrow, let's have
an "All-Together Bento Day" with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone makes their own bento box~
and then we all trade side dishes together~!
It sounds like fun, and it solves the problem, right?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying we should leave the solution to the students themselves...!
Hm, I had only been thinking of ways to open as usual, but if that's the case—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If the Student Council sends out a notice to the
entire academy right away, it doesn't seem impossible...!

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
That's a huge help~
We can't open the cafeteria, but you're more than welcome to use this space!

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see what kind of bentos the students will make~!
"And the next day, when I headed to the cafeteria, joyful voices could be heard from all around."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous☆ I packed all sorts of things in,
and made something totally brand new★

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it looks so colorful!
Just what I'd expect from Mave-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Laurel gets an omelet☆
Looks delicious~~♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun, thanks to you,
we somehow managed to overcome the crisis.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, it's a huge success.
That fantastic idea really saved us.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ahem♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: When Maya was little, we used to show each other our bento boxes at sports day.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Making octopus sausages,
or scrambled eggs!
It was all so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "I love the cafe's menu, but boxed lunches are a fun change of pace and I love them just as much!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... An idea born of childish whimsy,
yet brilliant precisely because of it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Is that supposed to be a compliment?
Boo-boo!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya worked really hard to make this bento, you know!
It's a super mature one!
choice_data_list: Did you make this all by yourself?
Did you make this all by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya worked really hard to make this bento, you know!
It's a super mature one!
choice_data_list: Did you make this all by yourself?
Did you make this all by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Really? Yay♪
Ehehe, maybe all my hard work paid off!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
As a thank-you for praising me,
I'll give Trainer-chan a bite too♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Here, say aaah♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... To be honest, I ended up asking
Bono-chan to help me out.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, Maya made sure to think
carefully about the seasoning, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's true, you know?
It's super delicious!
